gold_policy: expected_tables is the MINIMAL set of tables needed to answer the question, following the database's DECLARED foreign-key paths. Where a shortcut join exists that skips a declared FK (e.g. joining store straight to person because salesperson.businessentityid IS the person id), the declared path is used, because that is the path a schema-linking system can actually discover. Questions were written from the schema before any system was run on them.
